message.content: In mainstream Christian belief, **Jesus Christ** is viewed as the most pivotal “prophetic” figure because He fulfills all Old‑Testament prophecies concerning the Messiah and brings them to completion. While earlier prophets—Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and others—were crucial in shaping Israel’s faith, Christians see Jesus as the culmination of their messages, making Him the foremost prophet in Christian tradition.
